name: Assistance to Traditional Pottery Makers
benefit: The financial assistance of ₹25,000/- will be provided to the Traditional Pottery Makers for upgrading the occupation and purchasing machinery.
eligibility_rules: The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Kerala State.
The applicant should belong to the State Backward Community of Kerala State.
The applicant should be currently engaged in a traditional pottery-making occupation.
The annual family income of the applicant should be ₹1,00,000/-.
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline The completely filled Application Form along with all the relevant documents should be submitted before the Regional Deputy Director at the following addresses: Applicants From Trivandrum to Trissur: Regional Deputy Director, Backward Classes Development DepartmentCivil station, Kakkanad, Ernakulam- 682030, KeralaApplicants From Palakkad to Kasargode: Regional Deputy Director, Backward Classes Development DepartmentCivil Station, Kozhikode- 673020, Kerala
